recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration consider amending the internal rules to require formal approval from the Director-General of the United Nations Office at Geneva for the creation of any new reserve of the United Nations Staff Mutual Insurance Society against Sickness and Accidents in order to strengthen its management of reserves and ensure the Reserve Fund remains within a reasonable range.

history.administration_response: The Executive Committee made a recommendation in September to the Director-General to amend the internal rules in accordance with the Board’s recommendation. The Director-General approved that recommendation on 17 October 2023 with an effective date of 1 January 2025. The recommendation can therefore be closed. The supporting documentations has been uploaded to the shared folder.
history.board_assessment: Given that an amendment was made to the internal rules of the United Nations Staff Mutual Insurance Society against Sickness and Accidents, requiring that the creation of all new reserves and provisions must be approved by the Director-General, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
